mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key aspect of transnational relations among people and groups across national borders."
The business of infrastructure is a key aspect of transnational relations among people and groups across national borders.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of country capabilities to successfully implement its foreign policy, especially when those policies are opposed by other states or need the cooperation of other states."
National power is the sum of country capabilities to successfully implement its foreign policy, especially when those policies are opposed by other states or need the cooperation of other states.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most highly developed regional bloc in the world."
The European Union is the most highly developed regional bloc in the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum total of a country's capabilities."
Power is the sum total of a country's capabilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a multi-faced concept and has many forms, military muscle, wealth and some others that are fairly obvious tangible."
Indeed power is a multi-faced concept and has many forms, military muscle, wealth and some others that are fairly obvious tangible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the expectations actors hold about normal international relations."
International norms are the expectations actors hold about normal international relations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the much needed anti-dote to political shortsightedness and partisanship."
National policy is the much needed anti-dote to political shortsightedness and partisanship.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the UN Security Council which is made up of five great powers and ten rotating members that make decisions about international peace and security."
Parallel to the General Assembly is the UN Security Council which is made up of five great powers and ten rotating members that make decisions about international peace and security.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a force shaping power distribution in world politics today."
Globalization is a force shaping power distribution in world politics today.

Foreign Policy are the policies governments use to guide their actions in the international arena.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to any ratio of power capabilities between states or alliances, or it can mean only a relative equal ratio."
Balance can refer to any ratio of power capabilities between states or alliances, or it can mean only a relative equal ratio.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the social behaviour of individuals or groups aimed… or influenced by the existence or behaviour of individuals or groups belonging to different states (Dougherty and Pfatzgraft, 1971)."

International behaviour is the social behaviour of individuals or groups aimed… or influenced by the existence or behaviour of individuals or groups belonging to different states (Dougherty and Pfatzgraft, 1971).
